description: This file defines a Java class named 'CreditCard' that models credit card information, including card type, owner, number, expiration date, and CVV. It is designed as an embeddable entity for persistence in a database, with appropriate annotations for ORM (Object-Relational Mapping).

classes.name: CreditCard
classes.description: Embeddable Java class representing credit card details for payment processing, designed for persistence with JPA annotations.
